About Pip and Kip

This Astro setup is intentionally lightweight: shared layout, reusable sections, and clear places for external data.

Etsy and headless CMS integration can be handled through server-side endpoints, then rendered into existing cards and hero modules without changing page structure.

Current Stack

Astro pages and static components for performance and maintainability.

Near-Term Plan

Add API adapters in src/lib and fetch data in pages or endpoints.

Scale Path

Promote reusable sections into CMS-configured blocks with typed contracts.
